note: Zoom on the little pupil's desk corner of the cream-walled questions room (cartoon style, green carpet). The only word, la question (feminine): a whole girl standing beside the desk, kissing her teddy and holding a tall shepherd's crook bent like a question mark, on the left half. The blank card on the wall is the sign.
